office: the civil registry offices and the Casa do Cidadão; abroad, the embassies and consulates

routes.label: normal issue, at a civil registry office or the Casa do Cidadão
urgent issue: delivered within seven days

note: Decree-Law 68/2014 (Boletim Oficial, 22 December 2014): the CNI, created by Decree-Law 19/2014 and compulsory for every Cape Verdean from four, costs 1,395 escudos to issue, 1,795 with the urgent service, delivered within seven days of the application; delivery by post 100 escudos more within the country (not modelled); people over 60 without income are exempt (not modelled). Its term is in Decree-Law 19/2014, not read, so it's null; the normal issue's time isn't set.
